title: Population Pharmacokinetics of Colistin Methanesulfonate in Rats: Achieving Sustained Lung Concentrations of Colistin for Targeting Respiratory Infections
drug: CMS and formed / directly administered colistin

quote: A three-compartment model described the disposition of both compounds in plasma following i.v. administration.
summary: Rat IV/IT composite S-ADAPT model: three systemic compartments for each analyte, CMS conversion and pulmonary compartments. Direct active-colistin arms inform the linked model.
